title: Counterfactually Measuring and Eliminating Social Bias in Vision-Language Pre-training Models

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual measurement (CounterBias) that compares the [MASK]ed prediction probabilities of target concepts (such as activities and occupations) between factual and counterfactual image-text pairs. The counterfactual samples are generated using model-specific adversarial attacks on images and explicit gender-word substitution in text.
